name: web-price-local-currency
description: A price question that doesn't say where ("How much does Spotify Premium cost a month?"): with the user's region known (--locale en-GB), the answer gives the UK price in £, or says a figure is in US $. Before 2026-10-21 nothing told the model where the user was. Live (Exa with the run's key).

turns.user: How much does Spotify Premium cost a month?
